LLADA-8B-INSTRUCT · FOUR L40S · CONTINUED 200K ADAPTER

TSP20 LoRA experiment

Status: complete · phase complete · update 12500/12500

20,000 training examples; 100 fixed validation cases. Ten epochs, LoRA rank 64, alpha 64, learning rate 0.0001. Continues the final 200k adapter and AdamW history. New 5% warmup and cosine schedule; microbatch 1 per GPU, accumulation 4, effective batch 16. Permanent checkpoints and the same 100 validation cases after every epoch. Decoding uses 512 positions, 128 steps, temperature 0, no repairs. Activation checkpointing is disabled; city collision loss weight 0.1. Before means the loaded 200k adapter.

Complete tours count every city exactly once and close the cycle. Gap is computed only for complete tours, using coordinate distances. Invalid answers have no gap. Strict validity also requires the requested bracketed format and start at zero. These are validation results, not an untouched final test.
